description: Weekly count and average severity (1-10) of one symptom over the last 6 months. Use it to see when a symptom started, rose, or fell. The symptom must be an exact name from signal_list_tracked, e.g. fatigue or headache.

configuration.query: FROM health-timeline | WHERE kind == "symptom" AND name == ?symptom AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 180 days | STATS mentions = COUNT(*), avg_severity = ROUND(AVG(severity), 1) BY week = DATE_TRUNC(1 week, @timestamp) | SORT week ASC

symptom.description: Exact symptom name from signal_list_tracked, e.g. fatigue
